question: Which of the following is the the world's largest basaltic impact crater lake found in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **'__Lonar Lake__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The world's largest basaltic impact crater lake found in India is **Lonar Lake**.
 
• As per scientists, the crater was **formed after the area was hit by a comet or an asteroid** at a speed of around **90000 km per hour.**
 
• The lake's mean **diameter** is around **1.2 km **and the diameter of the **crater **on which the lake sits is **1.8 km.**
 
• The lake is both saline and alkaline in nature.
 
 
• The **outer region** has **pH 7** and is a neutral region.
 
• The **inner region** of the lake has a **pH of 11** and is alkaline in nature.
